Name: Children Mod
Author: echoiii
Description:
I made this mod because I was unhappy with the
default children & I wanted to add my personal touch.

CHANGES
-Adds a hooded fox onesie for females (hood down)
-Female toddlers now have pigtails/buns
-Adds a hooded bunny suit for males (hood up)

Installation Instructions
-Go to your "Characters" Folder
-Replace 
"Baby.xnb"
"Baby_dark.xnb"
"Toddler.xnb"
"Toddler_dark.xnb"
"Toddler_girl.xnb"
Toddler_girl_dark.xnb"

  With the provided files after creating backups of the original files.

To Uninstall
-Delete the modded files and replace with the original backups
